//: Vendored Seclayer module unit. The .ts files beside this config are byte-frozen (AS-IS-MANIFEST.json) and were written for the Seclayer service's bundler-based build, so this config mirrors that codebase's compiler settings instead of the runner's NodeNext/strict ones: moduleResolution Bundler and the service's selective strictness (strictNullChecks on; noImplicitAny deliberately off in the source — it reports thousands of errors there and is a different job). Type-only imports that would drag skip-set modules into the unit (scanner.js, crawler.js, challengePage.js, tlsProbe.js, scanEvents.js) resolve to the seam-authored .d.ts shims sitting at those relative locations in server/. The one bare runtime import, undici (server/ssrf.ts's SSRF-safe fetch dispatcher), is a real runner dependency — it is the mechanism of the DNS-rebinding guard and is not shimmed.
